artifacts.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: Xiaohongshu English-learning cover, page 1 of 5, vertical 3:4
Primary request: Create one photorealistic overhead photo of a real handwritten study-notebook page. Match the inspected 20260918 reference's tactile handmade feel: pale cream ruled paper, a narrow warm wood desk edge, soft natural window light, clear natural blue-black pen handwriting, sparse pale sage-green and soft-yellow underline accents. This is a new composition, not a collage.
Scene/backdrop: one open cream lined notebook sheet occupying almost the full frame; at the lower portion, a small simple blue-pen line drawing of a phone chat sending a file, with a visible document moving from one coworker to another. No abstract floating UI-card flowchart.
Composition/framing: near-overhead camera, vertical 3:4. Chinese hook is the complete first visual level at top; the full English A/B structures form the second level underneath. Small supporting drawing below. Keep all text and drawing inside 8% left/right and 10% bottom safe margins. Generous breathing room, strong mobile hierarchy.
Style/medium: photorealistic notebook photograph with authentic, legible human handwriting; simple blue-ballpoint doodle with clean open contours and no dense hatching. Do not imitate a printed poster.
Lighting/mood: calm daylight from a nearby window, soft natural shadows.
Color palette: cream paper, blue-black ink, pale sage green and soft yellow accents only.
Text (verbatim, and no other text):
"找同事要文件
请他发，还是向他要？
ask someone to do
ask someone for something"
Text accuracy: Render every Chinese character and every English word exactly. Spell English carefully: ask someone to do; ask someone for something. Do not omit, duplicate, paraphrase, add labels, page numbers, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
Constraints: Chinese hook first and complete; English A/B second and fully readable. Natural line breaks are allowed only as represented above. No other written characters anywhere, including on the phone or file icon. Exact 3:4 portrait.
artifacts.inspection: 实图通过：逐字准确；中文钩子第一层、完整英文 A/B 第二层；文件传递场景清楚；安全区与3:4通过。

artifacts.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: Xiaohongshu English-learning self-test, page 4 of 5, vertical 3:4
Primary request: A photorealistic near-overhead photo of a cream ruled notebook page continuing the exact 20260919 handmade visual language: natural blue-black handwriting, sparse pale sage-green and soft-yellow decorative underlines only, soft window daylight, narrow warm wood desk edge.
Scene/backdrop: Two equally weighted self-test scenes drawn in simple blue ballpoint. Upper scene: an adult holding a box with both hands asks Alex to open a door. Lower scene: the same adult asks Mia for a spare key. Keep people, viewpoint and line style consistent.
Composition/framing: Heading at top; question 1 with its full sentence stem and A/B choices beside the upper scene; question 2 with full stem and A/B choices beside the lower scene. Allow natural line wrapping. Keep everything within 8% side and 10% bottom safe margins.

Text (verbatim, no other text):
"换个场景，选更贴切的表达
1. 请 Alex 帮你开门：

A. to open the door

I asked Mia ___.
A. to open the door
B. for the key"
Text accuracy: exact Chinese, names, underscores, letters, punctuation. No extra text anywhere.

Constraints: exact 3:4 portrait, safe margins, no page number, logo, signature, or watermark.
artifacts.inspection: 实图通过：两题逐字准确；A/B同色同权重；无答案、勾叉、圈选或高亮暗示。
